caption: : Eval PPL. under different Sub-Dim Numbers settings.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) for two models—Transformer and MoHD—under varying numbers of sub-dimensions. The x-axis represents the "Numbers of Sub-Dims," ranging from 64 to 256 on a linear scale, with tick marks at 64, 128, and 256, and an additional label "1632" at the far left, which may indicate a baseline or reference point not part of the main range. The y-axis shows "Eval PPL," ranging from 9.5 to 12.5 on a linear scale, with tick marks every 0.5 units. The Transformer model is represented by a red dashed line with no markers, maintaining a constant Eval PPL of approximately 11.7 across all sub-dimension values. The MoHD model is represented by a blue solid line with square markers, showing a slight increase in Eval PPL from approximately 10.4 at 64 sub-dims to around 10.7 at 256 sub-dims, with minor fluctuations in between. The shaded region under the Transformer line suggests a baseline or comparison zone, but no specific values are provided for it.
